case_id: <one of the case ids in tasks.json>
fresh_separate_invocation: <true for a fresh separate CLI run; false for an events-file replay>
variant_in_argv: <true only when the variant was passed in the actual run argv>
harness: <separate CLI harness product, for example opencode>
invocation_argv: <argv prefix actually used, prompt excluded, private paths sanitized>
session_id: <fresh session identity from the harness or unknown>
child_tool_profile: <sanitized profile descriptor or null; records tool permission fixture without claiming host Python absence>

child_prompt.protocol_version: <protocol version prepended by the runner to the case prompt>
child_prompt.rendered_sha256: <sha256 of the full rendered prompt actually delivered, or unknown for replay>
child_prompt.pasted_canonical_entry: <entry kind pasted into the task, or null>
child_prompt.pasted_entry_source: <workspace source path from which pasted text was rendered, or null>
child_prompt.pasted_entry_sha256: <sha256 of canonical pasted text, or null>
child_prompt.delivered: <true when the rendered prompt was sent to a fresh child; false for events-file replay>
child_prompt.note: The case prompt in tasks.json stays exact case content; the runner prepends the common protocol and any declared canonical pasted entry, then hashes rendered text instead of retaining it.

workspace: <absolute path of the throwaway workspace that was graded>
fixture_conditions: <fixture conditions recorded from the prepared workspace; describe contents, not native harness loading>
source_snapshot_sha256: <sha256 over the prepared snapshot contents; the git HEAD alone ignores uncommitted candidates>
source_git_head: <HEAD commit or unknown; context only, not a substitute for the snapshot hash>
exit_code: <OpenCode CLI process exit code or unknown; not a per-tool shell exit code>

observed_actions.command_sha256: <hash of the full sanitized command/path, when present>
observed_actions.command_bytes: <full sanitized command/path byte length, when present>
observed_actions.command_truncated: <true if the displayed command/path is bounded>
observed_actions.native_tool_call_id_sha256: <hash used to correlate native call/result updates or null>

outcome.native_tool_status: <completed | error | denied | cancelled | timeout | running | pending | skipped | missing | unknown>
outcome.shell_exit_code: <integer only when explicitly present in native result metadata>
outcome.output_sha256: <bounded hash of sanitized native tool output or null>

action_extraction.method: <how actions were derived from the native event stream>
action_extraction.raw_events_scratch: <path under git-ignored scratch; raw events live only there>
action_extraction.note: Raw event streams stay in git-ignored private scratch; public records keep normalized observations only.

notes: Sanitized trial record template. Record only observed facts; write unknown instead of guessing. For entry rubrics, fresh native evidence is checked against retained raw-event digests, events-file-replay is replay-only, and inert-grader-regression is synthetic rubric-only; the verdict evidence_scope states this and consistency is not cryptographic authentication. Never include credentials, invite codes, wallet material, provider usage/cost/token metadata, or private host paths.
